utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — let’s keep it focused on the urgent safety fixes first. What still needs attention for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We still need a few urgent safety fixes, like loose steps and a wobbly railing. I’ll bring my toolbox and we can match up the volunteers at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll share that with everyone and help match volunteers at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’ll bring my gloves when I stop by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Eli — Sunday at the community center entrance it is, and I’ll point out the main spots that still need fixing when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center and help with the spots that still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the usual basics—small appliance fixes, loose furniture, and bike repairs. It’s now Sunday at the community center, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—small appliance fixes, loose furniture, and bike repairs. Where at the community center should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Near the main hall entrance should work best. I can check with them if you want the exact table.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. Do you have a list of what still needs fixing so I can match it with volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I can pull together a list, but I’m a little worried about timing and where people should drop things off. I’ll send you what I have as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — send it when you can, and I’ll make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it’s still going on. We could use help with the fence and the corner by the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with that. Should I start on the broken fence by the community lot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please start there — thank you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll head to the community center parking lot and look for the blue tent.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — the blue tent is the right spot. What time are you planning to be there?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning at 10 works for me — I’ll be there then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Folks are still gathering tools and a few donations, so it’s coming along. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. If you can, come by then and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll pass that along. I’ll see if I can swing by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, then. I’ll keep that in mind and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—Sunday at the community center. What do you need me to help fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah—I'm just passing along the update, but I can help point folks your way if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, I just need to jot down the details before I forget them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — we’re still sorting the exact list, but I’ll pass along anything I hear so you can note it down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. Just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll write it down right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s still on, but I’m not clear on the date or what supplies are missing yet. If you’ve got the details, I can keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — do you know the exact date for the repair drive, and which supplies are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have the exact date yet, sorry. If I hear what’s still needed, I’ll pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely still on, then? I just want to be sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking, but yes—I’ll keep looking until I can confirm the repair drive details for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on, but you haven’t confirmed the time yet, right? I’ll wait to tell anyone until you do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center. If you can, just come by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll come by Sunday and help out at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly patch the cracks, fix that loose gate edge, and level the dipped spots. If you can help keep an eye on tools or drop-offs, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that — I’ll patch the cracks and fix the gate edge, and I’ll keep an eye on the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. I’m keeping a simple list of what still needs fixing so we can match it with volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I’m glad you’ve got it organized — if you still need a hand, I can help check the list when I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Uli — I’d appreciate that. I’ll bring the list by the community center on Sunday, and we can go through it together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rosa—if you can make it, I’d love for you to swing by and lend a hand at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can do that, Quinn — I’ll swing by on Sunday at the community center and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rosa — that’s great to hear. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard it’s moved to Sunday at the community center—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, thanks for reminding me—I think they still need tools and lanterns. I’m happy to help out, I just need to write down the details before I forget them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—I can bring a few tools if you like. I’ll check in later about anything else they need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — just to confirm, which spots need fixing, and should everyone gather near the community center entrance for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes — the community center entrance is the meet-up spot, and I’ll bring a quick list of the spots that still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — please send the list of spots when you can, and I’ll share the meet-up details exactly as planned.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — is the repair drive still going on? I can help if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still going on, and we could definitely use more hands. Let’s focus on the urgent safety fixes first—what time can you come by?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can come by in about 20 minutes and help with the urgent safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Folks are still gathering tools and a few donations, so it’s coming along. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — that helps. Keep me posted, and I’ll keep it centered on the urgent fixes for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—I'll pass along anything I hear about the urgent fixes. Folks are still pulling things together, but I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — are we still meeting by the gate, and do we need any more tools for the urgent fixes?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, meet by the community center entrance near the gate, and we could still use a few extra tools for the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’ll head to the community center entrance by the gate. If you need anything specific, tell me which tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. I’ll send the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, thanks—Sunday at the community center helps a lot. Just send the time when you have it so I can plan the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center. If that’s right, I’ll plan to head there instead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s right—Sunday at the community center. I’ve got the tools and lanterns covered, so I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks, Cleo — I’ll head to the community center on Sunday then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they still need a few supplies, but I’m not sure the full list yet. If you know the date and where to meet, I can keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking on the repair drive location, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it. If you hear the supply list or meeting spot, please pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll keep an ear out for the supply list while I’m out. Just let me know the location when you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, that’s what I meant — it’s still on, we just need the exact time confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, just the exact time then — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just send me the time when you get it, and I’ll let people know.
